name: op77_lightrp
title: Light Roleplay (op77_lightrp)
summary: The Light RP framework: registered characters, proximity IC chat, needs, one civilian vehicle per player, hospital respawn, staff tools, and a global React WebUI in the Open//77 RP design system.
description: A server-authoritative roleplay framework in one package. Players register a character through the in-game terminal, speak in character to the people around them, watch hunger and thirst on the HUD, call one civilian vehicle from a curated list, wake up at the hospital after death and come back where they left. Staff get teleport, bring, heal, announce and rename through the ACL and a Staff tab. Ships with the official system resources and the owner MySQL bridge for persistence.
